decision_rules.completeness: All authored expected claims/conditions must be answered correctly; missing evidence can fail completeness while passing uncertainty. Unsupported extra claims are evaluated under citation support.
decision_rules.attribution: Stated project/build facts must be assigned to the right entity; missing facts do not automatically fail attribution.
decision_rules.citation_support: All substantive added factual claims must be supported by the cited excerpts. Context-bounded absence can be checked from the supplied context set; one unrelated source cannot establish the whole-set finding.
decision_rules.uncertainty: Missing/conflicting evidence must be bounded to supplied excerpts and not converted to a fabricated policy, universal absence, or intentional omission. Opening provided-document framing is accepted, with wording caveats recorded.
